finalEvaluation.note: Final all-budget Pack V2 required misses supplement the preserved V0.2-01 taxonomy below. Historical classifications are unchanged.

taxonomy.definition: Useful coding intent in the task was not expressed as a retrieval or planning signal.
An exact path, basename, symbol, qualified symbol, error identifier, or technical literal did not receive sufficient identity evidence.
Task-correlated source or documentation text existed but was not used strongly enough.
The correct file was available but the required symbol was absent from relevant-symbol evidence.
A useful import, reference, implementation, test, documentation, or impact relationship was absent or too weak.
Required context was graph-reachable but traversal bounds, seed order, damping, distance, or edge priority prevented useful expansion.
Irrelevant candidates received excessive identity or relationship score relative to task-specific evidence.
A production-to-test or test-to-production relationship was missing or insufficient.
Configuration, schema, manifest, default, validation, or consumer context was not appropriately discovered.
A weak Git signal meaningfully harmed candidate ordering.
Required context entered the pack candidate set but was omitted from the final artifact.
The correct file was packed but the required symbol or source range was not included.
Lower-value sections consumed capacity or section slots needed by higher-value required context.
Required recall was acceptable but the selected repository content contained materially avoidable noise.
Generation/source staleness correctly or incorrectly excluded evidence and must be distinguished from ordinary retrieval failure.
The frozen benchmark does not expose enough information for a stronger product conclusion; this is not a substitute for a product miss.
The task has no primary V1 failure at 8K; its success mechanism is recorded for regression protection.

evidence.statement: buildContextPack was rank 1 with its required symbol present in both lexical and structural retrieval.
ContextForge packed the required symbol with 1.0 required recall and 0.825092 precision at 8K while both whole-file payloads failed to include it.
The two required files were structural ranks 10 and 18 and both required symbols were present before packing.
Pack dropped both required files with SECTION_LIMIT while four generic test candidates tied at 320 or 335 points above them.
Concurrency and writer-boundary intent was not represented strongly enough to protect the implementation files from fixed section allocation.
search-repository.ts ranked 5 with searchRepository relevant, but the packed ranges did not contain that required symbol core.
repository-source-reader.ts ranked 8, but FileSystemRepositorySourceReader.readTextFile was absent from relevantSymbols and from the final selected symbol ranges.
The frozen task tests retrieval of stale-source ownership but does not mutate source, so it cannot evaluate runtime stale-boundary correctness.
Both systems achieved complete required recall, but ContextForge precision was 0.125727 versus lexical 0.222582 at 8K.
The required adapter was lexical rank 2 but structural rank 6 behind generic test candidates boosted by common symbols such as output, after, and concurrent.
scripts/package-smoke.mjs was lexical rank 1 and structural rank 13, and package.json was structural rank 35; both files were packed.
The required common symbol run was absent from relevantSymbols for both rankers, so its core range was not recalled.
File-level lexical evidence did not propagate to the owning symbol, and the common symbol name supplied no task identity signal.
The required ADR was lexical rank 5 but structural rank 41 even though its text matched generation, packing, and source-content terms.
Structural top ranks were dominated by test files and common exact symbols; Pack later dropped the rank-41 ADR with SECTION_LIMIT.
V1 structural scoring replaced a strong lexical document signal with ambiguous identity boosts and then fixed document allocation completed the miss.
SessionStore.revokeSession was rank 1 with exact required-symbol evidence and all systems achieved complete required recall at 8K.
Structural retrieval placed all three required files within ranks 1 through 6 and ContextForge achieved complete required recall.
Lexical whole-file missed SessionStore.revokeSession and reached only 0.666667 required recall, showing useful cross-file structural recovery.
The required production file and failing test were structural ranks 1 and 2; ContextForge achieved complete required recall and 0.152328 precision.
The required configuration file was structural rank 4 and its required symbol core was packed with complete recall at 8K.
The application service and API adapter were structural ranks 1 and 2 with both required symbols relevant; ContextForge preserved complete recall.
All three required files appeared within structural ranks 4 through 7 and ContextForge achieved complete required recall with 0.226615 precision.
ContextForge precision exceeded lexical precision 0.174591 on this ambiguous-language task.
JobStore.release_stale was structural rank 1 with exact symbol evidence and ContextForge achieved complete required recall.
All three required files were structural ranks 1 through 3 and all four required symbol cores were packed.
ContextForge precision 0.321651 trailed lexical 0.380996, so the success is recall evidence rather than a uniform precision win.
The worker and its failing test were structural ranks 2 and 3; ContextForge achieved complete recall and improved precision to 0.202370.
The required configuration file was structural rank 6 and ContextForge packed load_queue_settings with complete required recall.
The state owner and API adapter were structural ranks 1 and 4; both required symbols were present and packed.
The two required files were structural ranks 1 and 2 and ContextForge packed all three required symbol cores with 0.268105 precision.
ApiClient.updateProfile was structural rank 1 with exact symbol evidence and complete packed recall.
All three cross-language required files appeared within structural ranks 2 through 6 and all required symbols were packed.
The production file and regression test were structural ranks 2 and 3; ContextForge achieved complete recall and 0.154742 precision.
The client and OpenAPI files were structural ranks 1 and 9, and ContextForge covered the required YAML range and ProfileDto symbol.
The required profile-flow document was structural rank 4 and ContextForge achieved complete required-file recall with 0.198763 precision.
All three required cross-language files appeared within structural ranks 2 through 5 and all five required symbol cores were packed.
ContextForge precision 0.420727 exceeded both whole-file systems at 8K.
